name: artifact-monster-touch-feedback
description: Native C confirms silent refusal when a door-disguised mimic tries to absorb the carried Master Key of Thievery, followed by artifact speech and visible retained inventory. An ordinary key is absorbed after two actual waits; another is resisted. Object identity and pending JS continuation are established separately by source and read-only normal-import controls.
